defect: Initialize now sets the default temporary_directory on the instance config before Configure(), which then overwrites it from the user/default config, and Configure never copies the new options.database_path, so the storage manager gets an empty path.
reason: The fix writes the temp directory into config_ptr and copies database_path in Configure, repairing exactly the reordering and new path handling this change added.

defect: ExtensionPrefixPreOpen clears config.options.database_path before knowing whether the extension takes over the open, so any path matching the prefix pattern silently opens an in-memory database when ReplacementOpenPre returns null.
reason: This change uncommented the path clearing and placed it unconditionally; the fix moves it inside the success branch.

defect: The fix aligns the data size so the validity mask pointer after type_size*STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE bytes is aligned with non-standard vector sizes.
reason: The unaligned layout already existed before this change in AllocateVector and InitializeVector; the new copy function only repeated the existing pattern, and the fix mainly changes the allocation layout.

defect: The fix adds a STRUCT type check before StructValue::GetChildren on the ANY-typed storage_config parameter and renames error messages.
reason: The unchecked StructValue::GetChildren on storage_config already existed in the earlier enable_logging.cpp, of which this file is a re-added move.

defect: ListValueListFunction copies child lists into the result child vector without reserving capacity and assigns offsets sequentially instead of using the offsets of the input list entries, giving overflow and wrong lists for large or non-contiguous inputs.
reason: The new function added here is rewritten by the fix to reserve offset_sum and use col_offsets[c] + input offset.

defect: The new ValueIsCastable does not compile: it uses 'case default:', undefined identifiers value_ptr, size, vector_ptr and state_machine, and has no return on the default path.
reason: The fix repairs the syntax error and undefined identifiers in the lines this change added.

defect: ShredAnalysisState leaves type_id and decimal_type uninitialized, so ConstructShreddedType returns an indeterminate type when no primitive has a count (all-NULL values or empty arrays).
reason: The fix initializes both fields to INVALID, removing the uninitialized read in the struct this change added.

defect: ENUM ToString wraps KeywordHelper::WriteOptionallyQuoted(value, single quote) in additional single quotes, so values needing quoting come out double-quoted and break the exported schema.sql.
reason: The fix removes WriteOptionallyQuoted from the expression this change added.

defect: WriteTemporaryBuffer increases size on disk by buffer.size + 8 while FileBuffer::Write writes AllocSize bytes and DeleteTemporaryFile decreases by the real file size, so the temp size accounting drifts and can underflow.
reason: The fix changes the increment this change added to buffer.AllocSize() + sizeof(idx_t).

defect: Re-enabled CHECK evaluation also runs in Update on the updates chunk, which holds only the updated columns, so the table column indices of the check expression read the wrong or nonexistent columns.
reason: Besides the older NOT NULL index bug, the fix stops evaluating CHECK on the partial update chunk, a path this change made reachable.

defect: Dialect sniffing now calls TryParseCSV up to sample_chunks times per candidate; after the first call sniffed_column_counts already exceeds the == sample_chunk_size stop check, so each further call parses on through the file for every dialect candidate, a large auto-detect performance regression.
reason: The fix removes exactly the loop this change added and restores the single TryParseCSV call.

defect: Generic subquery-parameter binding was removed and the table-in-out path accepts only functions whose single argument is TABLE, so table functions taking a TABLE plus further parameters (Python map) can no longer bind their subquery argument.
reason: The fix restores the subquery branch this change deleted and relaxes the new arguments.size() == 1 check.

defect: The declaration of MapFunctionExec drops the input chunk while map.cpp still uses input, so the Python map function no longer compiles and loses its input.
reason: The fix changes the signature this change introduced back to an in-out form taking DataChunk &input.

defect: The FullScanHashTable moved into the executor comments out FillSelectionVectorSwitch, so sel_build and sel_addresses are passed to Gather uninitialized.
reason: The original JoinHashTable version filled the selection vectors; the fix re-enables the fill (the negative-key offset part of the fix concerns older code).

defect: PrintAllMetricsToSS writes extra_info into the JSON profiling output unescaped, whereas the code it replaced passed it through JSONSanitize, producing invalid JSON.
reason: The fix wraps GetExtraInfo() in JSONSanitize in the GetMetricAsString this change added.

defect: Inner joins now take the cross product + filter path only if the condition has a subquery, so join conditions with correlated column references go to CreateJoin, which cannot handle them.
reason: Before this change every inner join used the filter path; the fix adds HasCorrelatedColumns to the condition this change narrowed.

defect: StartExplainAnalyze was moved after the IsEnabled() early return, but IsEnabled() is only true for EXPLAIN ANALYZE once is_explain_analyze is set, so EXPLAIN ANALYZE without profiling enabled never starts the profiler.
reason: The fix moves the StartExplainAnalyze call back before the IsEnabled check.

defect: WKBColumnWriterState was changed to StandardColumnWriterState<string_t, string_t, ParquetCastOperator> while WKBColumnWriter is a StandardColumnWriter with ParquetStringOperator, so the writer casts its state to the wrong template subclass.
reason: The fix changes the operator template argument this change set back to ParquetStringOperator.

defect: Deserialize reads the new export_state field with ReadRequired, so FunctionExpressions serialized before this change (stored views and macros) can no longer be deserialized.
reason: The fix reads it with ReadField<bool>(false), restoring backward compatibility broken by this change.

defect: The new fast path checks the source validity only, so when lists have a length mismatch (marked NULL in the result only) it still casts and copies child data as if every list had array_size elements, and the slow path copies array_size elements from mismatched lists.
reason: The fix bases the fast-path check and the slow-path skip on the result validity, repairing the logic this change introduced.

defect: The new bit_state_t operations drop the FunctionData* parameter from Finalize (no longer matching the call in the aggregate executor) and Combine sets is_set even when the source state is empty, combining with the neutral value.
reason: The fix restores the Finalize signature and makes Combine respect is_set in the code this change rewrote.

defect: The added loop over loaded extensions pushes an extra result without extension_name for every loaded extension already seen in the install directory, producing bogus duplicate lines in UPDATE EXTENSIONS output.
reason: The fix deletes exactly the loop this change added.

defect: When an IN filter is pushed, Finalize now skips the min/max range filters, leaving only an OptionalFilter used for zonemap pruning, so probe-side scans lose their filtering, a performance regression.
reason: The fix makes PushInFilter void again and always pushes the min/max filters, reverting the skip this change added.

defect: The fix casts n - 1 to idx_t to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning.
reason: n is checked to be at least 1 just before, so the comparison was already correct and only a warning was removed.

defect: The new serialization check compares the full child type with the expected child type and throws an InternalException for valid values whose nested child types differ only in type info (aliases, nested child details).
reason: The fix replaces the strict inequality this change added with SerializeTypeMatches.

defect: The new information_schema.table_constraints view names every constraint after its first column, giving wrong PostgreSQL-style names for multi-column and check constraints.
reason: The fix changes the naming expression of the view this change added to omit the column for multi-column constraints.

defect: The automatic FIRST() rewrite wraps every non-aggregate select expression, including GROUP_REF references to group columns, breaking grouped queries such as TPC-H.
reason: The fix excludes GROUP_REF expressions from the rewrite this change added.

defect: has_result is computed as return_type == StatementReturnType::NOTHING, the inverse of its meaning, so result chaining keeps the results of the wrong statements.
reason: The fix changes the comparison this change added to QUERY_RESULT.

defect: The fix replaces the void_t-based has_serialize trait (by then moved to serialization_traits.hpp) with an enable_if/is_same detection and drops has_serialize_v, adapting the WriteValue enable_if this change added.
reason: The changed WriteValue line is only adapted to the removed helper; whether the original void_t trait was actually broken on a supported compiler cannot be told from the change, the fix and the repository.

defect: state.dictionary.Insert<true>(src_value) calls a member template on a dependent type without the template keyword, which does not compile on GCC/Clang.
reason: The fix adds the template keyword to exactly the two calls this change introduced.

defect: found_strings stores non-owning string_t values pointing into the input chunk, which are freed after Sink returns, so later deduplication lookups read dangling memory.
reason: The fix inserts the copy owned by the result vector into the set instead of the input string this change inserted.

defect: With the new is_null flag a NULL first value leaves state->value unset, yet Destroy still calls delete[] on it when it looks non-inlined, freeing an uninitialized pointer.
reason: The fix adds !state->is_null to the Destroy check, guarding the path this change created (the len+1 copy it also changes predates the change).

defect: In ExecuteLoop the !RIGHT_CONSTANT branch asserts restrict on ldata instead of rdata (copy-paste), so right-side aliasing is never checked and a constant left input is checked over count elements.
reason: The fix changes the second ASSERT_RESTRICT to use rdata in the file this change created.

defect: The fix removes a duplicate include of table_data_writer.hpp, which is already included at the top of the file.
reason: A second include of a pragma-once header is harmless; the removal is cleanup in an include-hygiene commit.

defect: ShouldRenderWhitespace loops with for (; x >= 0; x--) on an unsigned idx_t, an always-true comparison that fails the warnings-as-errors build.
reason: The fix replaces the tautological condition this change added, as its message says, to repair a compile error.

defect: The member copy_from_get_chunk has the same name as its typedef copy_from_get_chunk, which GCC rejects because the declaration changes the meaning of the name.
reason: The fix renames the typedef this change added to copy_from_get_chunk_t to fix GCC compilation.

defect: The new SAMPLE_SIZE -1 handling uses ULLONG_MAX without including a header that defines it, so the file does not compile on Linux.
reason: The fix replaces the ULLONG_MAX this change added with std::numeric_limits and adds the include.

defect: Inside function expressions the qualified column ref always gets its alias cleared, even when the original expression had an alias, so named parameters like f(name := col) lose their name.
reason: The fix restores a pre-existing alias first and clears only aliases added by qualification, reordering the branch this change wrote.

defect: ResolveDefaults indexes column_index_map by the logical oid while the binder in the same change now builds column_index_map over physical columns only, so tables with generated columns read the wrong or out-of-range map entries.
reason: The fix switches the lookups this change wrote to storage indexes (and binds defaults physically to match).

defect: The module-level from_parquet overloads declare the keyword-only union_by_name argument without a default, making it required and breaking existing duckdb.from_parquet(path) calls.
reason: The fix adds = false to the two py::arg declarations this change added.
